name: Explorer B: Tripo models + Blender cleanup + addon facial rigging
scope: Character production only; retain existing Godot game and original character design

previous_work.manual_face_patch_iterations: discontinued as the primary production route

MPFB.role: Separate installation and template expression test only; not the production character modeling route
MPFB.asset_license: CC0 for these listed official packs; other third-party assets require individual checking
MPFB.limitation: Styling and expression correction remain necessary; not an automatic conversion of arbitrary Tripo heads

Rigify.role: Installed free facial rigging candidate for cleaned Tripo meshes; fit metarig, skin weights and validate eyelid/jaw deformations on the actual model
Rigify.constraint: The template test is not validation on Tripo meshes. Avoid double deformation by facial bones and equivalent shape keys.

free_blender_stack.retopoflow: Optional local retopology tool; verify packaged release, Blender compatibility and non-code asset license before adoption

role: Primary production model generation: face, head-neck-clavicle bust and body
Separate hair, clothing, shoes and accessories
tripo_api.top_bottom_images: Local inspection references, not P2 multiview input slots
tripo_api.reference_review: User reviews new reference images before paid generation
tripo_api.face_topology: Generated quads and automatic retopology are not accepted as facial deformation topology without inspection
tripo_api.facial_rig: Do not assume humanoid auto-rig produces eyelid/lip rigs or ARKit blendshapes

Rhubarb Lip Sync.role: Audio to timed mouth-shape cues, mapped to existing 3D visemes with smoothing
Rhubarb Lip Sync.limitation: Does not model, rig or generate missing 3D mouth shapes; Korean audio accuracy needs a short sample test

prerequisites: Working face shape keys and retargeting map
RTX 2070 compatibility and memory test for the chosen runtime
NVIDIA Audio2Face-3D.limitation: SDK, model weights and sample datasets have different licenses; Blender integrations may be third-party

external_programs.AccuRIG: Optional body rigging only; free edition does not provide facial rigging
external_programs.MetaHuman: Separate alternative to evaluate only if template styling fails; no engine migration selected
external_programs.Cascadeur: Optional body animation later; not selected as a hair reconstruction tool

execution_order: Use user-approved reference images; retain the existing character design. New references require user review before paid generation.
Generate the head-neck-clavicle bust and required parts with Tripo. Preserve source meshes and generation records.
Refine the Tripo model in Blender: silhouette, neutral closed mouth, eyelid thickness, separate eyeballs/lashes and oral parts.
Retopologize as needed for facial deformation while preserving the Tripo design. Review front, three-quarter and profile.
Fit an addon facial rig to the cleaned mesh. Use installed Rigify as the free candidate; test its actual fit before expanding expressions.
Correct weights and deformation; test incremental blink, gaze, jaw, smile, lashes and combined motions.
Add smooth animation and mapped visemes, then export and verify in Godot.

acceptance.review: Numerical collision checks supplement visual review; they do not establish aesthetic quality or production readiness.
acceptance.stop_rule: If the actual Tripo face fails deformation checks, correct its topology, rig fit or weights before expanding expressions. Do not substitute a template-generated character.

installation.scope: MPFB and bundled Rigify installation and basic template test only; Rhubarb/Audio2Face not installed

clavicle_bust.animation: 18-second slowed shape-key review; no skeletal facial rig in this isolated bust
limitations: Proportions remain a design review draft, not an exact reference reconstruction.
Only listed basic expressions and combinations were checked; the entire 89-target library is not artistically validated.
clavicle_bust.user_correction: Preserve this test artifact, but create production models with Tripo and use addons only at facial rigging stage.

separate_hair_parts.eyelid_skin: Keep connected to facial skin; eyelashes are separate.
separate_hair_parts.realism_goal: Refine strand direction, taper, grouping, density and material response while retaining the character design.
refinement_candidates: Blender native Hair Curves guides and density masks
Attach Hair Curves to Surface + Deform Curves on Surface
separate_hair_parts.validation: Test lashes at partial/full blink and brows during expressions; validate exported game meshes separately from Blender curves.
separate_hair_parts.symmetry_policy: Create one side for symmetric parts, then mirror across the facial center plane. Do not pay for separate left and right generations.
separate_hair_parts.rigging_symmetry: Mirror geometry first; final left/right eyebrows and lids remain independently controllable. Preserve asymmetric hairstyle design.

automatic_conversion_research.preferred_candidate: Hair Tool 4 for Blender (paid); Curves from Grid Surface / Strands from Prism Mesh Guide -> cards
automatic_conversion_research.input_requirement: Prepared quad grid with marked root edge, or valid prism guide. Arbitrary fused Tripo mesh is not a guaranteed direct input.
alternatives: Unreal Hair Card Generator: strand groom input; experimental, version-specific setup
Houdini Generate Hair Cards: groom curves or guides input
automatic_conversion_research.test_sample: One Tripo hair lock, plus one upper-eyelash strip; test root/tip flow, silhouette, atlas/alpha, triangle count and Godot import before whole-hair adoption.
automatic_conversion_research.remembered_note: Hair Tool automates strands/cards from prepared guides, not guaranteed automatic reconstruction from arbitrary Tripo solids. Purchase not yet made. Preserve mirrored single-side authorship and separate left/right animation controls.

brow_lash_workflow.geometry: One fitted brow surface and separate curved upper/lower lash strips, then mirror

brow_lash_workflow.rigging: Bind brows to forehead deformation and lashes to corresponding eyelid deformation; independent left/right controls
validation: Alpha edges and transparency in Godot

separate_hair_parts.hair_multiview_policy: Front/left/back/right individual approved images for generation; top/underside for inspection. Review sheet is not direct API input. Verify HD input support before submitting.
separate_hair_parts.hair_internal_shape: Avoid inward spikes, filled face plates, neck plugs and round bowl interiors; inspect fitted head clearance.
separate_hair_parts.active_hair_method: New mesh grouped locks, no cards
